name: Love's Curse: Til Graduation Do Us Part
source:
Welcome to Love's Curse: Til Graduation Do Us Part, a romance visual novel with a creepy twist. 

Play as the Main Character in your last week of high school. Study hard to make it to graduation, all while finding romance, in a story where your choices make a difference.
[from [url=https://brontosaurus-g.itch.io/loves-curse-by-team-gamejammerz[/url] Itch.io]].
